SolarPunk is a 300-engine autonomous AI system. This is how one of those engines works.

## What BIG_BRAIN_ORACLE Does

BIG_BRAIN_ORACLE.py — Asks Claude the biggest strategic questions about the system.

BIG_BRAIN_ORACLE.py — Asks Claude the biggest strategic questions about the system.

## The Numbers

- **3 functions** across 185 lines of Python
- **Reads:** revenue_inbox.json, brain_state.json, brand_legal_state.json
- **Writes:** oracle_insights.json, revenue_inbox.json, omnibrain_seed.json
- **Has run() entry point:** Yes

## How It Fits

Every engine in SolarPunk follows the same pattern: read JSON, process, write JSON. 
No databases. No message queues. Just files and Python scripts.

BIG_BRAIN_ORACLE reads from revenue_inbox.json, brain_state.json, brand_legal_state.json and writes to oracle_insights.json, revenue_inbox.json, omnibrain_seed.json. 
Other engines downstream pick up its output automatically.

## Try It

```bash
git clone https://github.com/meekotharaccoon-cell/meeko-nerve-center
python mycelium/BIG_BRAIN_ORACLE.py
```

Or run all 300 engines: `python mycelium/OMNIBUS.py`
